import Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Kaehler
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Field
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Trace.Basic

/-!
# Differential trace for finite separable field extensions

For a finite separable extension `L/K`, the relative Kahler differentials
vanish.  The resulting base-change equivalence identifies `Ω[L/k]` with
`L ⊗[K] Ω[K/k]`; contracting the first factor with the field trace gives a
canonical `k`-linear differential trace.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open TensorProduct

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable

variable (k K L : Type u)
variable [Field k] [Field K] [Field L]
variable [Algebra k K] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L]
variable [IsScalarTower k K L]
variable [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]

private def traceTensorLinearMap :
    L ⊗[K] Ω[K⁄k] →ₗ[K] Ω[K⁄k] :=
  TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.lsmul K Ω[K⁄k]).comp (Algebra.trace K L))

/-- Differential trace along a separable field extension. Mathlib's field trace
and `finrank` normalization are both zero for infinite extensions. -/
def differentialTrace : Ω[L⁄k] →ₗ[k] Ω[K⁄k] := by
  let e : L ⊗[K] Ω[K⁄k] ≃ₗ[L] Ω[L⁄k] :=
    KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k K L
  let c : Ω[L⁄k] →ₗ[L] L ⊗[K] Ω[K⁄k] := e.symm.toLinearMap
  exact (traceTensorLinearMap k K L).restrictScalars k ∘ₗ c.restrictScalars k

theorem differentialTrace_smul_map (a : L) (ω : Ω[K⁄k]) :
    differentialTrace k K L
        (a • KaehlerDifferential.map k k K L ω) =
      Algebra.trace K L a • ω := by
  rw [differentialTrace]
  change traceTensorLinearMap k K L
      ((KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k K L).symm
        (a • KaehlerDifferential.map k k K L ω)) = _
  rw [← KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange_tmul]
  change traceTensorLinearMap k K L
      ((KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k K L).symm
        ((KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k K L)
          (a ⊗ₜ[K] ω))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

/- Pulling a differential up and then applying the differential trace scales
it by the degree of the finite separable extension.  This is the normalization
used when comparing pointwise residues under a finite map. -/
@[simp]
theorem differentialTrace_map (ω : Ω[K⁄k]) :
    differentialTrace k K L (KaehlerDifferential.map k k K L ω) =
      (Module.finrank K L : k) • ω := by
  have htrace : Algebra.trace K L 1 = (Module.finrank K L : K) := by
    simpa using Algebra.trace_algebraMap (R := K) (S := L) (1 : K)
  simpa [htrace, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using
    differentialTrace_smul_map k K L (1 : L) ω

@[simp]
theorem differentialTrace_D_algebraMap (f : K) :
    differentialTrace k K L (KaehlerDifferential.D k L (algebraMap K L f)) =
      (Module.finrank K L : k) • KaehlerDifferential.D k K f := by
  rw [differentialTrace]
  change traceTensorLinearMap k K L
      ((KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k K L).symm
        (KaehlerDifferential.D k L (algebraMap K L f))) = _
  rw [KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale_symm_D_algebraMap]
  have htrace : Algebra.trace K L 1 = (Module.finrank K L : K) := by
    simpa using Algebra.trace_algebraMap (R := K) (S := L) (1 : K)
  simp only [traceTensorLinearMap, TensorProduct.lift.tmul,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.lsmul_apply, htrace]
  simp only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

/-- Differential trace is surjective for finite separable field extensions,
including when the field characteristic divides the extension degree. -/
theorem differentialTrace_surjective [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Function.Surjective (differentialTrace k K L) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Algebra.trace_surjective K L (1 : K)
  intro ω
  refine ⟨a • KaehlerDifferential.map k k K L ω, ?_⟩
  rw [differentialTrace_smul_map, ha, one_smul]

end
end Hartshorne
